slides.sub: One of them just opened in September. Main Street is a block from the train.

slides.title: Fleur de Sel Patisserie & Bistro
slides.body: A French bakery and bistro. Its on-site kitchen bakes everything from scratch daily, from croissants to macarons.

slides.title: The Bagelry
slides.body: Opened Sept. 19, 2026. The bagels are rolled by hand, then boiled and baked on site.

slides.title: Chatham Bagels
slides.body: A Main Street bagel shop with egg sandwiches, breakfast wraps and spreads. It opens at 6 AM.
slides.source: Chatham Bagels on Postmates and MapQuest (Oct. 2026)

slides.title: Your Chatham bake shop stops
slides.tip: Before you make an offer, walk Main Street from Chatham station on a Saturday morning.
slides.source: Business pages (Oct. 2026); NJ Transit, Chatham Station

caption:
If you only remember one thing about Chatham, make it these 3 bake shops on Main Street.

Fleur de Sel Patisserie & Bistro at 265 Main St bakes everything from scratch in its on-site kitchen (closed Mondays). The Bagelry at 459 Main St opened in September 2026 with hand-rolled bagels baked on site. Chatham Bagels at 260 Main St opens at 6 AM with egg sandwiches and breakfast wraps. Before you make an offer, walk Main Street from Chatham station on a Saturday morning.
